findings.note: LANE F (desk #102), the FLOOR half. The flat pool itself is CODE and already shipped with this batch's earlier round (src/rules/build.ts flexibleCollectionSize + the collection branch, src/builder/Builder.tsx flat rail); this round adds the rule's only printed restriction - "you must select at least one 1st-level spell for your collection each time you prepare" (archetype-99) - to both surfaces: buildCharacter HOLDS the last place when no 1st-rank spell is collected, and the builder refuses the same pick with a plain message. NO FIELD CARRIES THE POOL SIZE, deliberately: print sizes it as "the total number of spell slots you get each day from your class spells", which is the character's own capped slot table, so a stored number would be a second copy of Table 5-1 that drifts the moment slotCap or a slot-bonus feat changes. The approvals entry for #102 (scripts/data/trust-approvals.json, record feats/flexible-spellcaster-dedication, fields spellSlotBonus + spellcastingGrant) is already load-bearing on spellSlotBonus - the record carries the cantrip give-back ladder and is absent from src/data/trust-ledger.json's off-list because the approval took it off - and spellcastingGrant is deliberately NOT authored: this archetype alters an existing class spellcasting, it grants none, so writing one would be an invented mechanic. The single row below is the PLAYER-FACING half of the ruling: the class-archetype note the sheet prints (src/sheet/FeatsTab.tsx:387) still described the collection without saying it is one flat pool or that one spell in it must be 1st rank. Pinned by test/batch037-flexible-spellcaster.test.tsx. Desk #155 (a flexible wizard/witch/magus takes the spellbook branch and gets no collection at all) stays OPEN and is untouched here.

backfillRows.value: Flexible Spellcaster: you prepare a spell COLLECTION rather than filling each slot, and can cast any spell in it using any slot of an appropriate rank. The collection is ONE pool, not a list per rank: it holds as many spells as the total spell slots you get each day from your class, in any mix of ranks, and at least one of them must be 1st rank. In exchange your slots per rank never advance past 2, and you learn 2 fewer class cantrips. Restricted slots (a wizard curriculum slot, a cleric divine font) are unaffected and their spells do not count toward the collection.
backfillRows.why: AoN archetype-99: "The number of spells in your spell collection each day equals the total number of spell slots you get each day from your class spells" and "The only restriction is that you must select at least one 1st-level spell for your collection each time you prepare, ensuring that you can use all your spell slots each day." The shipped note described the collection but named neither the flat size nor the 1st-rank floor, so the two rules the engine now enforces were nowhere on the player's sheet. Owner ruling 2026-09-10 #102.
